name: ai-memory
description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
one_liner: A memory bank for AI coding assistants so you can stop one tool mid-task, switch to a different AI tool, and have it pick up right where the last one left off.
buyer: A freelance developer or small dev shop juggling multiple AI coding tools who is tired of re-explaining project context every time they switch vendors.
business_use_cases: A dev agency standardizes on this so a junior developer can hand off an in-progress AI-assisted task to a senior developer's preferred tool without a re-briefing meeting.
A solo SaaS founder avoids vendor lock-in, switching between Claude Code and Codex depending on which is cheaper or better that week.
A dev-tools vendor integrates it as a selling point, 'works with your memory, not just ours,' to court users wary of being locked into one AI coding tool.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, synced version of the memory store shared across a whole team, billed per seat.

steal_this: Install it on your own multi-tool workflow this weekend and document the time saved from not re-explaining context, then turn that into a case study to sell team licenses.
